messages:
amy-sales: Quick thread — AcmeBank POC: they need strict EU/EEA residency and visibility into subprocessors. Questions from their infosec: 1) can hosted be configured to never egress outside EU/EEA? 2) which subprocessors operate in EU vs globally? 3) do UK regions count as EU for you? 4) any pricing uplift for EU-only reserved capacity? Need answers by COB Mon so they can decide between hosted POC or Dedicated trial. @mike-se please own.

mike-se: Ill take this. Short version: hosted supports region-pinning and intra-EU failover. Well not route to non-EU unless allow_cross_region_fallback is true. For an absolute legal guarantee (no chance of any non-EU execution or state hydration) recommend Dedicated or Private.

tom-eng: Example YAML we give customers to show security teams (POC-friendly):

```yaml
routing_policy:
  pin_regions:
    - eu-central-1
  preferred_failover:
    - eu-west-3
  allow_cross_region_fallback: false
  support_access_restrictions:
    support_in_region_only: true
```

Notes: the flag allow_cross_region_fallback:false prevents any fallback to non-EU regions under our hosted control. support_in_region_only toggles whether support sessions spawn from EU staff/infra (paid add-on).

nina-security: High-level subprocessor summary we can share: cloud infra providers (AWS/GCP operating EU regions) = processors; CDN/edge (Cloudflare) = edge routing + metadata (we can configure EU-only POPs for strict customers); metrics/observability vendors = support/processors for telemetry (EU tenancy available); backups/DR vendors = processing (encrypted-at-rest, retained in EU unless cross-region DR opted in). Full export = compliance portal link (will attach).

nina-security: Important security caveat to include when presenting to infosec: hosted intra-region failover will recreate runtimes in target EU region and may hydrate KV/prefix cache from source replicas during warmup. That flow can generate transient reads; Dedicated/Private with controlled replication removes that risk. Also we support customer-managed keys (CMEK) for Dedicated and Private; hosted supports CMEK for enterprise plans (ask for entitlement). We also support mTLS for control-plane hooks and TLS 1.2+/modern ciphers for all data-in-flight.

jules-legal: We can provide an EU-only routing addendum and a subprocessor exhibit. Action items for legal: get the customer's legal definition of "EU/EEA" (do they want UK included?), confirm if they need SCCs, and whether they require subprocessors to sign localization attestations. Timeline: we can draft a one-page addendum next business day after we get the definition.

kevin-ps: Pricing context: EU-only reserved pools typically carry a regional uplift due to capacity and license variances. Ballpark: +20% to +35% versus mixed-global reserved pricing depending on GPU SKU and zone. For POC we can offer a short-term EU-only hosted POC with a capped credit to absorb part of the uplift. If they choose Dedicated commitments, we can model fixed monthly price. Ill produce two quick scenarios (hosted EU-pinned POC vs Dedicated EU-only) with sample numbers by EOD tomorrow.

amy-sales: Customer also asked: what about support engineers or incident responders in US having to access logs for debugging? They want proof we can restrict support to EU personnel for this engagement.

mike-se: We have two options: 1) Support access restricted to EU staff + audit trail — available as a paid support plan (we can enforce session origin). 2) If they need zero-external-personnel access, Dedicated + customer-run ops is the route. We'll prepare a short security posture note for the customer showing the enforcement options.

deploy-bot: Created ticket #SL-14678: export current EU subprocessors inventory, certs, and hosting region list. Assigned to nina-security.

amy-sales: Next steps: (1) nina-security attach the subproc export and the short security note on cache-hydration risks; (2) tom-eng attach the YAML and a one-paragraph explainer of failover behavior; (3) jules-legal start EU routing addendum draft and confirm UK handling; (4) kevin-ps deliver POC vs Dedicated pricing scenarios. Ill close loop with the customer once we have those pieces. Thanks team. :pray:
